empty.title: Add a plant first
empty.text: An assessment belongs to one of your plants. Add a plant, then come back here.

details.title: Assessment details
details.desc: Choose the plant and the monitoring period you are entering readings for.
details.datesHint: Filled from the period; you may change them within the period.

conflict.duplicate: An assessment already exists for this plant, starting month and length ({period}).
conflict.overlap: This period overlaps an existing assessment of the same length ({period}). Periods of different lengths may overlap, same-length periods may not.

indicators.title: Choose indicators by group
indicators.desc: Select a whole group or individual indicators adopted at {plant}.
indicators.selectedCount: {count, plural, one {# indicator selected} other {# indicators selected}}

noneAdopted.title: No indicators are adopted at this plant
noneAdopted.text: Adopt the indicators you want to monitor from “Performance indicators”, then come back to start the assessment.

readings.title: Enter readings
readings.desc: Derived values are calculated automatically and inputs are checked as you type.
readings.errorCount: {count, plural, one {# error to fix} other {# errors to fix}}
readings.valueWaiting: The value appears once the required fields are filled.
readings.valueFix: Fix the error to see the value.
readings.notePlaceholder: Anything the reviewer should know about this reading

review.title: Review data
review.desc: Check the readings before approving. No result is shown for an indicator with incomplete data.
review.previewNote: Status preview uses your current limits. The approved status is decided on the server when you approve.
review.errorsTitle: You cannot approve while there are input errors.
review.errorsFix: Fix {count, plural, one {# indicator} other {# indicators}} in the readings step:
review.missingTitle: Missing data in {count, plural, one {# indicator} other {# indicators}}:
review.missingText: They will be marked “Insufficient data” with no result.
review.ack: I confirm approving with missing data, and that this will be recorded in the audit trail.

bar.incomplete: {count, plural, one {# indicator without complete data} other {# indicators without complete data}}

delete.title: Delete this draft?
delete.text: The draft and the readings entered so far will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

processing.title: Approving the assessment
processing.text: Calculating values and comparing them with the limits…

toast.draftSaved: Draft saved — you can finish it later

errors.futurePeriod: The period must end in the current month or earlier.
errors.outsidePeriod: The date must be inside the monitoring period.
errors.beforeStart: The end date is before the start date.
errors.not_integer: Enter a whole number, without decimals.
errors.out_of_range: A percentage must be between 0 and 100.
errors.exceeds_denominator: This cannot be larger than the total.
errors.zero_denominator: The total must be greater than zero.
errors.summary: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
errors.validation: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
errors.plantNotFound: We could not find this plant in your account.
errors.indicatorNotAdopted: One of the selected indicators is not adopted at this plant.
errors.readingNotSelected: A reading does not belong to the selected indicators.
errors.inputErrors: Some readings have input errors. Fix them and try again.
errors.missingData: Some indicators have incomplete data. Tick the acknowledgement to approve.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
